title: Tulip Mania Peak & Collapse
description: One of the earliest recorded speculative asset bubbles. Contract prices for bulbs of the fashionable Tulip reached extraordinarily high levels before collapsing rapidly in February 1637.

title: South Sea Bubble
description: Speculative bubble in South Sea Company stock driven by guaranteed government debt conversion rights and public enthusiasm, culminating in a severe crash.

title: Wall Street Crash of 1929
description: The most devastating stock market crash in United States history, signaling the beginning of the 12-year Great Depression.

title: Japanese Asset Price Bubble
description: Real estate and stock market bubble in Japan driven by monetary easing and credit expansion. The Nikkei 225 peaked in December 1989 at 38,915.

references.name: Bank of Japan Asset Bubble Study

title: Dot-com Technology Bubble Peak
description: Rapid inflation of equity valuations of internet-based technology companies. NASDAQ Composite peaked at 5,048.62 on 10 March 2000 before declining 78%.

references.name: NASDAQ Composite Historical Data
references.organization: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis / FRED

title: US Subprime Housing Bubble
description: Nationwide housing price expansion funded by subprime mortgage securitization and synthetic financial instruments, triggering the 2008 Global Financial Crisis.

title: Global Crypto & NFT Expansion
description: Rapid appreciation across digital assets and decentralized finance protocols, reaching a total market capitalization peak of ~$3.0 Trillion in November 2021.
